name: add-bookkeeping-only-ci-fast-lane
title: Add a bookkeeping-only CI fast lane
description: Reduce redundant CI cost and merge latency for exact-head finish-work task/archive/journal successors without weakening branch protection, metadata validation, or fail-closed full-CI behavior.
creator: sdelmas
notes: Implemented the prior-head classifier, canonical bookkeeping validation lane, mode-strict CI Result aggregate, full-only auto-tag guard, contributor/spec contract, and 21 focused classifier/workflow tests. Focused risk evidence covers typed API payloads, Git failures and unavailable evidence, explicit workflow environment inputs, regular-file/path/size boundaries, exact normalized SHA/run identities, and bounded diagnostics; Zizmor, ShellCheck, Ruff, mypy, all test shards, coverage, and the full-check with the external KB lane disabled pass. The canonical finish-work and review contracts still create archive/journal commits before one final push. Exact-head PR dogfood and the linked Obsidian KB refresh remain for the PR lifecycle.
